notes: Round-89 C1 blind cases authored by seat R89MScoutCases. INDEPENDENT of the candidate tool: build/mado-mako.c1.py and tools/mado-mako.py were not opened. Every pattern below is the post-tokenizer value derived by reading upstream mako v1.11.0 criteria.c parse_criteria (162-262) and apply_criteria_field (267-411), plus config.c load_config_file (780-885); every verdict comes from the POSIX ERE oracle controls/posix-ere-oracle.c (libc regcomp(REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) + regexec, C locale - mako never calls setlocale) built at $S/ore. Upstream sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emersion/mako/v1.11.0/criteria.c, .../config.c and the v1.11.0 tag tarball. The 'oracle' field is the oracle's own verdict per criteria field; 'undecided' marks the cases where no regex verdict applies (the section is refused before matching). DRAFT contribution for L1 review - not a measurement.

cases.pin: criteria.c:333 regcomp(value, REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB); a POSIX bracket range [b-d] is an ERE set (regex(7)); criteria.c:115-119 match_regex_criteria -> regexec matches 'c' Oracle trace: regcomp('[b-d]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('c') -> match.
criteria.c:47-58 match_regex_criteria returns false on REG_NOMATCH; 'e' is outside [b-d] Oracle trace: regcomp('[b-d]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('e') -> nomatch.
criteria.c:333 a POSIX negated set [^abc] matches any byte other than a/b/c; criteria.c:115-119 regexec Oracle trace: regcomp('[^abc]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('z') -> match.
criteria.c:47-58 REG_NOMATCH -> the section does not match; criteria.c:115-119 Oracle trace: regcomp('[^abc]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:333 REG_NOSUB (regex.h:323) suppresses submatch *reporting* only, so a capture group still compiles and matches; criteria.c:115-119 regexec Oracle trace: regcomp('(ab)+', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('abab') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 sees '\\' -> MAKO_PARSE_STATE_ESCAPE and criteria.c:177-182 appends the next character verbatim while dropping the backslash, so the regcomp input is '(a)\1'; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds (a glibc ERE backreference extension, not POSIX) and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches 'aa' Oracle trace: regcomp('(a)\\1', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('aa') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 + 177-182 turn '\\1' into '\1'; criteria.c:333-336 regcomp('\1') fails (REG_ESUBREG) -> 'Invalid summary~ regex' -> apply_criteria_field false -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section Oracle trace: regcomp('\\1', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> invalid.

glibc anchors each alternation branch independently, so '^a' matches 'a'; criteria.c:333 regcomp, criteria.c:115-119 regexec Oracle trace: regcomp('^a|b$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> match.
'^a' needs a leading 'a' and 'b$' a trailing 'b', so 'xa' matches neither branch; criteria.c:47-58 REG_NOMATCH Oracle trace: regcomp('^a|b$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('xa') -> nomatch.
the 'b$' branch matches the trailing 'b' of 'xb'; criteria.c:115-119 regexec Oracle trace: regcomp('^a|b$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('xb') -> match.

mako never calls setlocale, so the C locale applies and '.' is one byte; criteria.c:333 regcomp, criteria.c:115-119 regexec on 'x' Oracle trace: regcomp('.$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('x') -> match.
POSIX '.' matches a space (no REG_NEWLINE is passed, criteria.c:333); criteria.c:115-119 regexec Oracle trace: regcomp('a.b', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a b') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 '\\' -> ESCAPE, criteria.c:177-182 drops the backslash and keeps the next character, so the regcomp input is '(x)' - a capture group, NOT literal parentheses; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches the bare text 'x' Oracle trace: regcomp('(x)', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('x') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 + 177-182 drop the backslash, so the regcomp input is '['; criteria.c:333-336 regcomp('[') fails (REG_BADPAT) -> 'Invalid summary~ regex' -> refusal Oracle trace: regcomp('[', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('[') -> invalid.

tokenizer: criteria.c:207-215 splits on a single space only, so the section yields the tokens 'summary~=Setup' and 'Wi-Fi'; criteria.c:269 strstr(key,'=') is NULL for the second token, criteria.c:272-286 treat it as a boolean field, and criteria.c:399-407 rejects it ('Invalid boolean criteria field') -> apply_criteria_field false -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section Oracle trace: no pattern reaches regcomp (the section is refused while the criteria are parsed).

tokenizer: criteria.c:207-215 splits on the single space, giving the two tokens 'summary~=Setup' and 'app-name=alpha'; criteria.c:332-339 compiles the regex 'Setup' and criteria.c:298-303 stores app_name 'alpha', so the space does NOT become part of the regex value; criteria.c:74-77 and 115-119 both hold -> the section applies Oracle trace: regcomp('Setup', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('Setup') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:184-196 QUOTE state, criteria.c:186-188 '\\' -> QUOTE_ESCAPE and criteria.c:177-182 keeps the escaped quote verbatim, so the regcomp input is 'say "hi"'; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds ('"' is an ordinary byte in an ERE) and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches Oracle trace: regcomp('say "hi"', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('say "hi"') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:204-206 a '"' in the NORMAL state opens a quoted run (criteria.c:184-196) and criteria.c:189-190 closes it, so both '"' characters are dropped and the regcomp input is 'sayhi'; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches 'sayhi' Oracle trace: regcomp('sayhi', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('sayhi') -> match.

criteria.c:269 strstr(key,'=') splits at the FIRST '=' only, so the value is 'a=b'; criteria.c:333 regcomp('a=b') succeeds ('=' is an ordinary byte) and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches 'a=b' Oracle trace: regcomp('a=b', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a=b') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 + 177-182 drop the backslash, so the regcomp input is 'a.b' where '.' is the ERE any-character operator, not a literal dot; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches 'axb' Oracle trace: regcomp('a.b', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('axb') -> match.

tokenizer: criteria.c:199-215 + 177-182 turn '\\.' into a single backslash followed by '.', so the regcomp input is 'a\.b' where '\.' is a literal dot; criteria.c:333 regcomp succeeds and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches the literal text 'a.b' Oracle trace: regcomp('a\\.b', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a.b') -> match.

same pattern as b21 (criteria.c:177-182): '\.' is a literal dot, so 'axb' does not match; criteria.c:47-58 REG_NOMATCH Oracle trace: regcomp('a\\.b', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('axb') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:127-131 body_pattern is matched against notif->body via match_regex_criteria (criteria.c:47-58); '^beta$' anchors both ends Oracle trace: regcomp('^beta$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('beta') -> match.

criteria.c:47-58 regexec REG_NOMATCH: '$' anchors at the very end of the body, so 'beta ' does not match '^beta$' Oracle trace: regcomp('^beta$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('beta ') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:127-131 body_pattern is only satisfiable when the notification carries a body; with no --body input the criterion cannot be satisfied and the tool refuses it (same tool stance as the round-89 draft case r19, whose oracle verdict is likewise 'undecided') Oracle trace: no pattern reaches regcomp (the section is refused while the criteria are parsed).

criteria.c:115-119 and 127-131 are two independent tests that must both hold; criteria.c:498-551 validate_criteria only refuses 'summary'+'summary~' and 'body'+'body~', so summary~ + body~ in one section is legal Oracle trace: regcomp('alpha', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('alpha') -> match; regcomp('beta', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('beta') -> match.

criteria.c:127-131 the body~ branch fails on 'gamma', so match_criteria returns false and the section does not apply; the matching summary~ branch alone is not enough Oracle trace: regcomp('alpha', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('alpha') -> match; regcomp('beta', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('gamma') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:298-303 app-name is a strcmp test and criteria.c:115-119 the regex test; both must hold for match_criteria to return true Oracle trace: regcomp('x', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('x') -> match.
criteria.c:115-119 the summary~ branch fails on 'y' -> match_criteria false -> no section match Oracle trace: regcomp('x', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('y') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:308-313 urgency is compared as an enum (parse_urgency, criteria.c:264-271) and criteria.c:115-119 the regex test; both must hold Oracle trace: regcomp('x', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('x') -> match.

criteria.c:91-93 the urgency test fails (critical != normal) -> match_criteria returns false before the regex test; the regex itself still matches, so the section is skipped rather than refused Oracle trace: regcomp('x', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('x') -> match.

criteria.c:207-215 and 241-247 call apply_criteria_field once per token; criteria.c:332-339 regcomp writes into the same criteria->summary_pattern each time, so the later token's pattern is the one left compiled and criteria.c:115-119 matches 'beta' (glibc regcomp over an already-used regex_t replaces the compiled program) Oracle trace: regcomp('beta', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('beta') -> match.

same last-token-wins rule as b32 (criteria.c:332-339): the surviving pattern is 'beta', which does not match 'alpha' Oracle trace: regcomp('beta', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('alpha') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:333-336 regcomp('[abc') fails (REG_EBRACK, unmatched left bracket) -> 'Invalid summary~ regex' -> apply_criteria_field false -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section Oracle trace: regcomp('[abc', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> invalid.

criteria.c:333-336 regcomp('*a') fails (REG_BADRPT: no preceding re for the repetition operator) -> refusal; POSIX ERE rejects a leading '*' Oracle trace: regcomp('*a', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> invalid.

criteria.c:333 regcomp('a)') succeeds on glibc (an unmatched ')' is an ordinary byte there; regex.h:367 notes REG_ERPAREN is 'not returned from regcomp'); criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches the literal text 'a)' Oracle trace: regcomp('a)', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a)') -> match.

criteria.c:333 regcomp('x|') succeeds (the empty second branch matches the empty string at offset 0) and criteria.c:115-119 regexec therefore matches any text Oracle trace: regcomp('x|', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('zzz') -> match.

a POSIX bracket class [:digit:] inside a negated set (regex(7)); criteria.c:333 regcomp, criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches 'a' Oracle trace: regcomp('[^[:digit:]]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('a') -> match.
'5' is a digit, so the negated POSIX class does not match it; criteria.c:47-58 REG_NOMATCH Oracle trace: regcomp('[^[:digit:]]', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('5') -> nomatch.

tokenizer: criteria.c:201-203 '\\' -> MAKO_PARSE_STATE_ESCAPE and criteria.c:228-236 rejects a section that ends in the ESCAPE state ('Trailing backslash in criteria definition') -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section Oracle trace: no pattern reaches regcomp (the section is refused while the criteria are parsed).

tokenizer: criteria.c:204-206 opens a quoted run and criteria.c:228-231 rejects a section that ends in the QUOTE state ('Unmatched quote in criteria definition') -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section Oracle trace: no pattern reaches regcomp (the section is refused while the criteria are parsed).

mako never calls setlocale, so the C locale applies and each byte is one character: the two-byte UTF-8 e-acute is two characters, so '^..$' matches it (criteria.c:333 regcomp, criteria.c:115-119 regexec). Under a UTF-8 locale the same pattern would NOT match Oracle trace: regcomp('^..$', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('é') -> match.

criteria.c:269-286 splits at the FIRST '=' and criteria.c:332-339 regcomp's the whole value; the '!' negation prefix of criteria.c:281-285 only applies to a BARE key (no '='), so here '!' is an ordinary byte of the regex and criteria.c:115-119 regexec matches the literal text '!x' Oracle trace: regcomp('!x', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('!x') -> match.

criteria.c:127-131 body_pattern is matched against notif->body, never against notif->summary, so the body~ branch fails on 'delta' even though the summary is 'gamma'; criteria.c:47-58 REG_NOMATCH Oracle trace: regcomp('gamma', REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB) then regexec('delta') -> nomatch.

criteria.c:267-272 apply_criteria_field splits at the '=' and gets the key '!summary~', which is not one of the known fields (criteria.c:297-373), so criteria.c:399-407 prints 'Invalid criteria field '!summary~'' and returns false -> parse_criteria false -> config.c:844-848 refuses the section; the '!' negation of criteria.c:281-285 applies only to a bare key Oracle trace: no pattern reaches regcomp (the section is refused while the criteria are parsed).
